title: moduleResourceLocation
responsibility: Resolve module resource destinations while preserving revision scope.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.scope
inputs.description: The revision branch and commit are copied into the returned location. No other location context is accepted or preserved.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.module
inputs.description: This module identifier is prefixed to the resource id when no catalog destination is declared. It does not affect catalog routes and is not validated here.

inputs.name: moduleResourceLocation.resource
inputs.description: The resource catalog selects a destination: permissions and module-library map to the permissions and modules screens, while styles and dependencies map to same-named screens. Any other present catalog becomes the category; without a catalog, the destination is the module-resources screen with entity `${module}.${resource.id}`.

outputs.name: moduleResourceLocation
outputs.description: The returned location copies branch and commit and selects fields for the destination. Page screens use category pages plus a screen, other declared catalogs become the category directly, and a missing catalog uses pages, module-resources, and entity `${module}.${resource.id}`.
